translations.web: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.
translations.bsb: Lashes and wounds scour evil, and beatings cleanse the inmost parts.
translations.kjv: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil: so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.
translations.asv: Stripes that wound cleanse away evil; And strokes reach the innermost parts.
